lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੧੦ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag soohee mahalaa 3 ghar 10 ||
lines.translation: Raag Soohee, Third Mehl, Tenth House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਨੀਆ ਨ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਜੋ ਮਰਿ ਵੰਞਸੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: duneeaa na saalaahi jo mar va(n)njasee ||
lines.translation: Do not praise the world; it shall simply pass away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲੋਕਾ ਨ ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਜੋ ਮਰਿ ਖਾਕੁ ਥੀਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: lokaa na saalaahi jo mar khaak theeee ||1||
lines.translation: Do not praise other people; they shall die and turn to dust. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਵਾਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: vaahu mere saahibaa vaahu ||
lines.translation: Waaho! Waaho! Hail, hail to my Lord and Master.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ ਸਚਾ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh sadaa salaaheeai sachaa veparavaahu ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: As Gurmukh, forever praise the One who is forever True, Independent and Carefree. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਨੀਆ ਕੇਰੀ ਦੋਸਤੀ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਦਝਿ ਮਰੰਨਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: duneeaa keree dosatee manamukh dajh mara(n)n ||
lines.translation: Making worldly friendships, the self-willed manmukhs burn and die.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਬਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਹਿ ਵੇਲਾ ਨ ਲਾਹੰਨਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jam pur badhe maareeahi velaa na laaha(n)n ||2||
lines.translation: In the City of Death, they are bound and gagged and beaten; this opportunity shall never come again. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਕਾਰਥਾ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਗੰਨਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh janam sakaarathaa sachai sabad laga(n)n ||
lines.translation: The lives of the Gurmukhs are fruitful and blessed; they are committed to the True Word of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਸਹਜੇ ਸੁਖਿ ਰਹੰਨਿ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: aatam raam pragaasiaa sahaje sukh raha(n)n ||3||
lines.translation: Their souls are illuminated by the Lord, and they dwell in peace and pleasure. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਰਚੰਨਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kaa sabad visaariaa doojai bhaai racha(n)n ||
lines.translation: Those who forget the Word of the Guru's Shabad are engrossed in the love of duality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸਨਾ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਲਤ ਫਿਰੰਨਿ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: tisanaa bhukh na utarai anadin jalat phira(n)n ||4||
lines.translation: Their hunger and thirst never leave them, and night and day, they wander around burning. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਸਟਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਦੋਸਤੀ ਨਾਲਿ ਸੰਤਾ ਵੈਰੁ ਕਰੰਨਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: dusataa naal dosatee naal sa(n)taa vair kara(n)n ||
lines.translation: Those who make friendships with the wicked, and harbor animosity to the Saints,

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਡੁਬੇ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਿਉ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੁਲ ਡੋਬੰਨਿ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: aap dube kuta(n)b siu sagale kul doba(n)n ||5||
lines.translation: shall drown with their families, and their entire lineage shall be obliterated. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਾ ਭਲੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਕੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੁਗਧ ਕਰੰਨਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ni(n)daa bhalee kisai kee naahee manamukh mugadh kara(n)n ||
lines.translation: It is not good to slander anyone, but the foolish, self-willed manmukhs still do it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੁਹ ਕਾਲੇ ਤਿਨ ਨਿੰਦਕਾ ਨਰਕੇ ਘੋਰਿ ਪਵੰਨਿ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: muh kaale tin ni(n)dakaa narake ghor pava(n)n ||6||
lines.translation: The faces of the slanderers turn black, and they fall into the most horrible hell. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਏ ਮਨ ਜੈਸਾ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਤੈਸਾ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਤੇਹੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: e man jaisaa sevahi taisaa hovahi tehe karam kamaai ||
lines.translation: O mind, as you serve, so do you become, and so are the deeds that you do.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਬੀਜਿ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਖਾਵਣਾ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: aap beej aape hee khaavanaa kahanaa kichhoo na jaai ||7||
lines.translation: Whatever you yourself plant, that is what you shall have to eat; nothing else can be said about this. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਪੁਰਖਾ ਕਾ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਿਤੈ ਪਰਥਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: mahaa purakhaa kaa bolanaa hovai kitai parathaai ||
lines.translation: The speech of the great spiritual beings has a higher purpose.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਭਰੇ ਭਰਪੂਰ ਹਹਿ ਓਨਾ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਤਮਾਇ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: oi a(n)mrit bhare bharapoor hahi onaa til na tamaai ||8||
lines.translation: They are filled to over-flowing with Ambrosial Nectar, and they have absolutely no greed at all. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣਕਾਰੀ ਗੁਣ ਸੰਘਰੈ ਅਵਰਾ ਉਪਦੇਸੇਨਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: gunakaaree gun sa(n)gharai avaraa upadesen ||
lines.translation: The virtuous accumulate virtue, and teach others.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਿ ਓਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਏਨਿ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: se vadabhaagee j onaa mil rahe anadin naam laen ||9||
lines.translation: Those who meet with them are so very fortunate; night and day, they chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਸੀ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਸੰਬਾਹਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਈ ਮੇਦਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: desee rijak sa(n)baahi jin upaaee medanee ||
lines.translation: He who created the Universe, gives sustenance to it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਹੈ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਸਚਾ ਆਪਿ ਧਣੀ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: eko hai daataar sachaa aap dhanee ||10||
lines.translation: The One Lord alone is the Great Giver. He Himself is the True Master. ||10||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: so sach terai naal hai guramukh nadar nihaal ||
lines.translation: That True Lord is always with you; the Gurmukh is blessed with His Glance of Grace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: aape bakhase mel lae so prabh sadaa samaal ||11||
lines.translation: He Himself shall forgive you, and merge you into Himself; forever cherish and contemplate God. ||11||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਮੈਲਾ ਸਚੁ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: man mailaa sach niramalaa kiu kar miliaa jaai ||
lines.translation: The mind is impure; only the True Lord is pure. So how can it merge into Him?

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਤਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਇ ॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: prabh mele taa mil rahai haumai sabad jalaai ||12||
lines.translation: God merges it into Himself, and then it remains merged; through the Word of His Shabad, the ego is burnt away. ||12||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਸਚਾ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: so sahu sachaa veesarai dhrig jeevan sa(n)saar ||
lines.translation: Cursed is the life in this world, of one who forgets her True Husband Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਨਾ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: nadar kare naa veesarai guramatee veechaar ||13||
lines.translation: The Lord grants His Mercy, and she does not forget Him, if she contemplates the Guru's Teachings. ||13||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਤਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹਾ ਸਾਚੁ ਰਖਾ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur mele taa mil rahaa saach rakhaa ur dhaar ||
lines.translation: The True Guru unites her, and so she remains united with Him, with the True Lord enshrined within her heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਵੀਛੁੜੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: miliaa hoi na veechhuRai gur kai het piaar ||14||
lines.translation: And so united, she will not be separated again; she remains in the love and affection of the Guru. ||14||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਿਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਆਪਣਾ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: pir saalaahee aapanaa gur kai sabad veechaar ||
lines.translation: I praise my Husband Lord, contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤੀ ਨਾਰਿ ॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: mil preetam sukh paaiaa sobhaava(n)tee naar ||15||
lines.translation: Meeting with my Beloved, I have found peace; I am His most beautiful and happy soul-bride. ||15||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮਨੁ ਨ ਭਿਜਈ ਅਤਿ ਮੈਲੇ ਚਿਤਿ ਕਠੋਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh man na bhijaee at maile chit kathor ||
lines.translation: The mind of the self-willed manmukh is not softened; his consciousness is totally polluted and stone-hearted.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਪੈ ਦੁਧੁ ਪੀਆਈਐ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਿਸੁ ਨਿਕੋਰ ॥੧੬॥
lines.transliteration: sapai dudh peeaaeeai a(n)dar vis nikor ||16||
lines.translation: Even if the venomous snake is fed on milk, it shall still be filled with poison. ||16||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap kare kis aakheeai aape bakhasanahaar ||
lines.translation: He Himself does - who else should I ask? He Himself is the Forgiving Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਮੈਲੁ ਉਤਰੈ ਤਾ ਸਚੁ ਬਣਿਆ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥੧੭॥
lines.transliteration: gurasabadee mail utarai taa sach baniaa seegaar ||17||
lines.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, filth is washed away, and then, one is embellished with the ornament of Truth. ||17||
